questions.cardText:
[History] Where is the ancient city of Babylon located in modern-day geography?
A. Egypt
B. Iraq
C. Iran
Answer: B.
questions.de: In welchem heutigen Land liegen die Ruinen der antiken Stadt Babylon?
questions.en: In which modern-day country do the ruins of the ancient city of Babylon lie?

timeline.labelEn: Reign of Hammurabi, the Babylonian king famous for his law code
timeline.labelDe: Herrschaft Hammurabis, des für seine Gesetzessammlung berühmten babylonischen Königs

questions.notes: Card confirmed: Babylon lies in modern Hillah, Babil Governorate, Iraq, about 85 km south of Baghdad.

questions.cardText:
[Literature] What type of narrative is the following? “Long ago, the sun goddess Solaria wept tears of fire that fell to the earth, creating the first volcanoes. Whenever Solaria mourns the loss of a hero, a volcano erupts.”
A. A myth
B. A legend
C. A fable
Answer: A. A myth is a story that explains natural events, cultural practices, or the origins of the world. It often involves gods or supernatural beings. A legend is an embellished story based on historical events, and a fable usually highlights a moral message.
questions.de: Wie heißt die Art traditioneller Erzählung – etwa die Geschichte einer Sonnengöttin, deren Feuertränen die ersten Vulkane erschufen –, die Naturereignisse oder Ursprünge erklärt und meist Götter oder übernatürliche Wesen zeigt?
questions.en: What kind of traditional story — like a tale of a sun goddess whose tears of fire created the first volcanoes — explains natural events or origins and usually features gods or supernatural beings?

timeline.labelEn: William Bascom's study sets apart myth, legend and folktale as forms of prose narrative
timeline.labelDe: William Bascoms Studie grenzt Mythos, Sage und Märchen als Formen der Prosaerzählung voneinander ab

questions.notes: Card confirmed: myths' main characters are usually gods and other supernatural figures, origin myths explain how things came to be; legends are mostly secular with human protagonists (Bascom 1965). The card's Solaria story is invented.
